format_probed: render/closing-r5-dpm/out/d-a0/a0-cal-2048.txt.gz (header 'timeline: regs ...' then 'tl <ns> <hex per reg>'), and its .after.regs.txt.gz head (reg 0xADDR 0xVAL lines)
units: a job = one out/**/<case>.txt.gz with a 'timeline: regs' header and 'tl ' lines (columns by header; 0x0710 and 0x0748 must be in the header); after-read = <case>.after.regs.txt.gz 'reg 0x071c 0x...' lines
G: global page count of a job = max over its tl lines of (0x072c >> 16) if 0x072c is in the header (the high half step E873/E1013 bracket); fallback none (job excluded from the 6+ split, listed)
H0: bits 31:16 of 0x0710 are 0 in every tl line of every job, and bits 31:16 of 0x071c are 0 in every after-read, whatever G. Pass: zero non-zero high halves. Refuted by one sample (report job, line, G).
H-TAIL: once G >= 6 the 0x0710 (or 0x071c) high half is non-zero (holds the tail page or count) in some sample of the job; scored per job with G>=6 (pass if non-zero seen)
H-ANY: some sample anywhere has a non-zero high half

bit2.per_job: n = tl lines, c = lines with bit 2 clear, p = partial renders (number of separate stretches of 0x0658 bit0 set), has = c > 0
bit2.fit_rows: sessions render/closing-r1-pixgeo, closing-r2-geo, closing-r3-geo, closing-r3-geo-c (earliest sessions that sample 0x0748)
bit2.held_out: all jobs of closing-r5-dpm closing-r6-dpm closing-r7-dpm closing-r8-ldpm closing-r9-ldpm closing-r10-dpm closing-s1 closing-s1b (any session dir matching closing-r*/closing-s* not in fit rows) with 0x0748 in the header
bit2.R-LEN: P(has) = 1-(1-q)^n, q = sum c / sum n over fit rows
bit2.R-PR: P(has) = 1-exp(-r*p), r = sum c / sum p over fit rows (only fit jobs with p>0)
bit2.R-0x100: P(has) = f100 if the job's cases.tsv/args or name contains '0x100' else f_other; f = fraction of fit jobs with has in that class
bit2.R-CONST: P(has) = fraction of fit jobs with has (null)
bit2.score: total log-loss and Brier on has over held-out jobs, split by max G <= 5 vs 6+; the lowest log-loss wins a split; if fit rows have no clear lines or no 6+ held-out jobs exist, report bit 2 as not cleanly scorable and give H0 alone

pass_H0: zero non-zero high halves in 0x0710 samples and 0x071c after-reads over all sessions closing-r* and closing-s*
